senses.gloss: as preced. Pi. Ib. 8ᵇ השתא נַוּוּלֵי מְנַוֵּויל לה וכ׳ since the law requires her disgrace (by stripping her upper body), can there be any question as to these (jewels)? Ḥull. 11ᵇ נִינַוְּולֵיה we may dishonor his body (by a postmortem examination); a. e.
to be disfigured, disgraced. Ib. הא קא מִינַּוֵּול he would be disgraced (by autopsy, v. supra).
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 8b:3">B. Bath. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>האי קא מינוול וכ׳</he> the one (put to death by the sword) is disfigured &c.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 154b:4">Ib. 154ᵇ</cite> <he>לִינַּוּוֵל ולינוול</he> let him be disgraced (by autopsy, v. supra); a. e.—V. <cite ref="M01738"><he>מְנַוַּולְתָּא</he></cite>.
